title: 電動キックスクーター
description: バッテリーデッキ、前後のタイヤ、ハブモーター、折りたたみ部、ブレーキレバーとケーブル、泥よけ、ライト、反射板、展開したスタンドを備えた無銘の電動キックスクーター。静止した配置用小道具で、走行機能・安全性・機構の作動は未検証。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Unbranded electric kick scooter with battery deck, profiled tires, rear hub-motor cover, folding collar, connected brake cable and lever, mudguards, lamps, reflectors and deployed kickstand. Static placement prop; not rigged and not validated for riding, safety or mechanical operation. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
